notes: Each allowance is the latest figure the FIA's own reports state ("the fifth (5th) of the four (4) new … allowed"), kept in the shared store; one pinned by hand is marked as such.
Usage is counted per car: a stand-in uses, and adds to, the allocation of the car they drive (Article B8.2.7).
Every count and penalty is read from the FIA Technical Delegate's reports and the stewards' decisions. Grid outcomes come from the published starting grid.
A document the FIA withdraws, rescinds or replaces stops counting, and is listed below with the reason.
